# RMD-E03 — Plan → Feature Gating Matrix

**Decision node.** Maps API route-groups to the **minimum plan** (`minPlan`) required.
Enforced by `withAuth(handler, { ..., minPlan })` → `src/lib/planGate.js` (402
`PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED` when the tenant's plan is below the threshold).

Plan order (ascending): **FREE < STARTER < PRO < ENTERPRISE** (`Tenant.plan`, default `STARTER`).

> Drafted as a sensible SaaS default by the architect (2026-07-18) for RMD-E04/E05 to
> apply. **Business owner may adjust any row** — E04/E05 read `minPlan` straight from
> this table, so changing a value here + rerunning the batch is the whole edit.

## Core — ungated (all plans, incl. FREE)
The day-one CRM/POS surface. **No `minPlan`.**

| Route group | minPlan |
|---|---|
| `orders`, `pos` | — (none) |
| `customers`, `crm` | — |
| `kitchen`, `inventory`, `procurement` | — |
| `enrollments`, `courses`, `schedules` | — |
| `tasks` | — |
| `employees`, `tenants`, `settings` | — |
| `auth`, `webhooks`, `liff` | — (public / self-gated) |

## Gated route-groups

| Route group | minPlan | Rationale | Applied by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `automations` | **PRO** | Workflow automation is a premium capability | RMD-E04 |
| `ai` | **PRO** | AI reply / sentiment / sales-closer / nl2sql | RMD-E04 |
| `marketing` | **PRO** | Campaign management + marketing memory | RMD-E04 |
| `analytics` | **STARTER** | Dashboards/KPIs — included for any paid plan | RMD-E05 |
| `ads` | **PRO** | Ad-spend management / attribution | RMD-E05 |
| `integrations` | **ENTERPRISE** | Third-party / accounting-sync integrations | RMD-E05 |

## Rules for E04/E05 (mechanical)
1. For each route file under a gated group, add `minPlan: '<value>'` to the existing
   `withAuth(handler, { ... })` options object. **No logic edits.**
2. Leave routes in **Core** untouched.
3. Public/self-gated routes (`auth`, `webhooks`, `liff`) are never plan-gated.
4. A route already carrying a stricter `minPlan` is left as-is (never downgrade).
